annotations.title: Get deadline changes for an EU tender

description: Observed submission-deadline changes, per lot, for a watched TED tender, with the old and new deadline (local and UTC) and links to both official notices. Also returns the current deadlines. Pass next_cursor or checkpoint_cursor back as cursor to page or to poll for new changes. Uses the free tier, or the caller's API key.

cursor.description: Optional cursor from a previous answer

notice_id.description: TED publication number of the watched tender, e.g. 662865-2026

name: get_tender_deadline_changes
